cover_considerations_sql: CREATE TABLE cover_considerations (consideration_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(consideration_id GLOB 'cover_consideration_[0-9a-f]*' AND length(consideration_id)=84), review_case_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES review_cases(review_case_id), report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES metadata_reports(report_id), replay_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(replay_digest)=64 AND replay_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), document_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_digest)=64 AND document_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), supersedes_id TEXT REFERENCES cover_considerations(consideration_id), occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(occurred_at>=0), currentness_document TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(currentness_document)='text' AND length(CAST(currentness_document AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 4 AND 4096), document TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(document)='text' AND length(CAST(document AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 2 AND 12582912))
